{"id":"mimid-1wgh.44.21","title":"Decision: draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08 is track-only for mimid","description":"Assay mimid-1wgh.44.6 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08.txt (sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

RECOMMEND: track only, keep decision mimid-1wgh.4.12 (refuse SemiPrivateMessage handshakes; providers see group changes as PublicMessage).

Why: individual draft, Informational (L3), one author; -08 changed only suggested codepoints (A.1, L476-478); Security Considerations is 'TODO More Security' (L404); no implementation in OpenMLS or mls-rs to test against. protocol-07 allows a SemiPrivateMessage handshake in §5.3 UpdateRequest and §5.5 FanoutMessage (protocol-07 txt L1519, L1529, L2044, L2054) and suggests it (L1582-1585), so a peer could send one; mimid refuses it today (crates/mimi-protocol/src/lib.rs:67-71). No peer we test with (Haven, Phoenix) sends one.

If adopted later, features to build (file then): (1) mimi-mls wire: decode SemiPrivateMessage, SemiPrivateMessageContent, KeyForExternalReceiver (§3.1 L229-347); (2) the hub as an external receiver: an HPKE key pair, published in the room's external_receivers component (§3 L155-158), decrypt per §3.3 L375-385, verify framed_content_tbs_hash and the signature; (3) members: send SemiPrivateMessage when mls_semiprivate_message is in required_wire_formats (§3 L173-179), wire format 0x0011 (suggested, L410); (4) protocol: accept it in UpdateRequest and FanoutMessage.

No conflict with existing mimid code or decisions beyond the known refusal.
